artworks.title: Woman's Head on a Pedestal
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract figure with a long, spiraled column base topped by a bust resembling a human face. The figure is crowned with leaf-like patterns, and on either side of the column, there are symmetrical arrangements of fruit and foliage hanging from delicate strings. Below these, to the left and right, there are two abstract winged insects.

artworks.title: Hercules with His Club
artworks.description: The figure stands behind a rectangular pedestal, extending from head to mid-thigh. The person has a bearded face, curly hair, and a serious expression. They wear loose garments, with a hand-woven lion pelt draped over one shoulder. The lion's head rests on their chest, and they hold a large club-like object with one hand. The background includes tall grass, a small stream, and a leafless tree on the right. Above the figure, ornate designs frame the scene, with leafy garlands, tassels, and ornamental faces with wings.

artworks.title: Sphinx Wearing a Crescent on Her Head
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical or fantastical figure with ornamental designs. The central figure is a stylized embodiment that merges human and architectural elements, featuring a human-like face with elaborate, geometric and organic shapes forming the body. The figure is highly symmetrical, standing on what appears to be a pedestal. It is adorned with intricate floral and vine-like motifs extending outward. These elements suggest a blend of human form with floral and decorative design. The entire composition is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Bearded Head on a Pedestal
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an intricately designed heraldic figure. A central human bust with a bearded male visage sits atop a pedestalesque construct adorned with decorative scrollwork and hanging tassels. Crossed swords, each adorned with circular shields, extend from either side of the bust. Suspended from the swords are garlands that include various botanical elements such as leaves, vines, and possibly fruits. The piece is rich in detail with intricate shading, creating texture and depth, giving it a primarily ornamental and emblematic appearance.

artworks.title: Diana of Ephesus
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure from the waist up, centrally positioned and facing mostly forward with a slight turn of the head to the side. The person's facial features are finely detailed with soft expressions and delicate, flowing hair that is long and wavy, cascading down past the shoulders. They wear intricate robes, with the upper garment resembling a draped cloth covering most of the chest and arms, while the lower part consists of detailed patterns resembling scales or spheres. The surroundings include decorative elements like fantastical creatures resembling lobsters and bats, a fortress or castle-like structure on the person's head, and additional floral and ornamental swirls with human faces and birds. The background is a textured canvas, adding aged character to the detailed design.

artworks.title: Woman with Left Profile
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved illustration of a sculpture of a classical female figure. The figure is partially draped in flowing fabric, standing in a contrapposto pose. The engraving is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and grey. The figure stands on an ornate pedestal with decorative elements. Floral and faunal motifs surround the sculpture, including garlands, swans, and curling vines. The sculpture faces slightly to the left with its head tilted downwards.

artworks.title: Satyr with Twisted Legs
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a mythical figure. The central figure has a human torso and a goat head with horns and a beard. The figure stands on a twisted column with decorative elements like a lion mask at the base. The figure holds a bowl or platter on its head with botanical elements spilling over. On each side, there are hanging shields with animal faces. The background shows a stone archway and wall. The drawing has intricate details and a mystical tone, similar to Renaissance artwork.

artworks.title: Pan
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a mythical figure standing upright on a pedestal. The figure has the legs and hooves of an animal resembling a satyr, with a full, curly beard, short, curly hair, and a flat object on top. They wear a draped garment covering their torso, revealing textured legs. The figure holds panpipes in one hand. The background has a line design with clusters of fruits and leaves tied with ribbons on each side. The scene is framed within an oval shape on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Old Man Warming His Hands
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in an elegant pose with one arm extended forward. His head is slightly tilted. He has a long beard, wears a close-fitting cap, and voluminous robes that flow to the floor. Surrounding him are an oval mirror-like object, sconces with flames, a large urn, a scroll or cylindrical object, and a decorative mounting at his feet. The background is detailed with line work.

artworks.title: The Genius of Franklin (Au Génie de Franklin)
artworks.medium: etching in brown ink on antique laid handmade paper

artworks.title: Title Page: Oval Design from the Church of San Michele de Bosco, Bologna
artworks.artist: Jean Claude Richard de Saint-Non after Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Carlo Cignani
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cherubic figures holding a curtain to reveal a large oval inscription. The drawing shows two child-like figures, one on either side of an oval-shaped frame with written text inside. The figures are holding up draped fabric, as if unveiling or presenting the central inscription. The scene is rendered in monochromatic tones with attention to line and shading, suggesting depth and texture in the fabric and the figures. The overall composition suggests a sense of formality. The details are stylized, emphasizing the curvature and posture of the cherubic figures and the flow of the draping.

artworks.title: John the Baptist Beheaded
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in an architectural setting with figures engaged in various activities. The scene features a classical-style building with large columns and arches. A group of figures are gathered inside at a table. In the foreground, there are two figures outside the building; one is handing something to the other, who is carrying a platter. Another figure is kneeling on the ground with a hunched animal at their side. In the background, another structure can be seen along with more figures and a landscape that includes trees and a windmill. The detailed line work and shading suggest a Renaissance style, focusing on classical architecture and human activities.

artworks.title: Parable of Weeds in the Wheat
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with clusters of buildings and a church or tower on distant hills. Fine brushstrokes create a detailed and textured appearance. Two figures are conversing in the foreground; one points forward and wears a robe and headgear, while the other stands barefoot. Nearby, another figure feeds a fire with sticks. In the background, a horse-drawn cart and workers are seen in the fields. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and brown, adding to the vintage style and historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Christ  Admonishes His Disciples
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.6 × 6.3 cm (2 5/8 × 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts five men standing under a large, leafy tree. One man is slightly separated from the group and reaching out towards the tree. He has long hair and a beard, wearing a flowing robe. The other four men are standing together, each with varied facial hair and hair lengths, dressed in robes. There are no visible jewelry or objects. In the background, there is a detailed cityscape with buildings, towers, bridges, and hills. The scene is depicted in a black and white style.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a central figure hovering in the air, surrounded by an oval glow. Various figures below are kneeling or gesturing towards this entity, with clouds framing the upper portion of the image. Two additional figures on either side are elevated above the ground level. The ground is rocky with sparse vegetation. The scene is detailed with line work giving texture to garments, clouds, and natural elements.

artworks.title: The Servant Begging for Mercy from His King
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with several figures engaged in conversation and transactions. The scene features a group of individuals under an elaborate archway with classical columns. A seated figure on the right is positioned at a table covered with a cloth, where various items are placed. The individual appears to be engaged in a discussion with another figure kneeling before the table, while another figure with a helmet and shield stands nearby. In the background, architectural details such as other arches, windows, and a distant building with a dome can be seen, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: The Birth of John the Baptist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 5.1 cm (2 3/8 × 2 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a domestic scene showing the birth of a child. It features intricate architectural details like columns and patterned floors. On the left, a woman is lying in a bed, while individuals attend to the newborn in a basin. On the right, figures are gathered around a table, engaged in conversation or celebration. The composition is divided into two segments, highlighting the intimacy of the birth and the societal norms of the time portrayed through clothing and building style.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimme to plate mark): 6.4 × 6.2 cm (2 1/2 × 2 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a richly detailed interior space with architectural elements such as arches and columns. The scene is set in an enclosed room that features intricate tile flooring and intricate wood paneling on the ceiling. In the foreground, a container with a plant arranged ornately is displayed on the tiled floor. At the rear of the room, an ornately draped bed with a fine canopy is visible. The windows are latticed, allowing light to filter into the room, casting a subtle glow on the settings. The overall composition is focused on a symmetrical design and detailed line work that highlights the craftsmanship of the architectural elements and decor.

artworks.title: The Marriage of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 5.8 cm (2 3/8 × 2 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior scene. The image depicts an interior of a building with vaulted ceilings and a series of columns lining the corridor. At the center of the scene, beneath the arches, there is an area set up for a ceremony or event. The columns support semicircular arches, creating a sense of depth and focusing the viewer's attention toward the central area. The drawing highlights the texture of the stonework and the architectural fineries, with light and shadow portrayed to enhance the three-dimensionality of the space. The use of line work is meticulous and precise, contributing to the ornate and formal atmosphere of the setting.

artworks.title: Mary and Joseph Find the Boy Jesus in the Temple with the Doctors
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.7 × 6.2 cm (2 5/8 × 2 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with classical architectural elements. The image depicts an ornate building interior with lined columns creating distinct sections. The ceiling features semi-circular arches, and draperies overlay the structure. At the back of the room, there is an elevated structure, possibly an altar, framed by detailed carvings and additional columns. Text is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 5.5 cm (2 5/16 × 2 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. On the left, a woman is seated with her body oriented towards the right. Her hair is partially covered and cascades down, as if draped with a cloth. She has a serene expression, rests one hand on her chest, and holds an open book with the other. She is dressed in a long, flowing gown. To the right is a standing figure with outstretched wings, holding a staff topped with a cross. This figure has curly hair and is dressed in a robe. Between them is a large vase containing a single lily. The setting is an indoor environment with geometric tiles on the floor, arches, columns, and a wooden ceiling. In the background, three windows show an exterior landscape with hills and a bird in flight.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.9 × 6.2 cm (2 11/16 × 2 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people seated or kneeling in various positions within a rustic structure with a thatched roof. A woman is seated to the right, looking down at an infant laid in a manger. The woman wears a draped garment with a halo around her head and has long, flowing hair visible beneath a veil. The undressed infant is peacefully resting with arms extended. Other individuals around them appear to offer gifts or express awe, dressed in simple robes and some holding staffs. One of the kneeling figures has a short, curly hairstyle and seems to present a basket of fruit. The background features a pastoral landscape with distant buildings and rolling hills under a clear sky with celestial symbols, including a star.

artworks.title: Joseph, Mary and Jesus Returning to Nazareth
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 × 6 cm (2 9/16 × 2 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a family returning to a city. The scene depicts a journey towards a walled city with grand architecture and visible figures of livestock and people in the background. Rolling hills and sparse trees line the path, adding depth to the landscape. Closer to the forefront, there is a family unit, the first walking energetically, elongated in form, leading the way, carrying a stick over the shoulder. The second figure follows, with a flowing robe, and another smaller figure seeks support from the second figure. Below the scene, a caption is etched with text. The artwork uses intricate linework and hatching to convey texture and detail throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Christ Healing a Deaf Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring several figures by a river. The composition depicts a group of figures in robes, with one figure kneeling, others standing and gesturing towards the kneeling figure, and additional figures observing. The background shows a landscape with trees, hills, and a winding river. The architectural style hints at a historical or religious context, reminiscent of Renaissance art. The artwork is done in fine lines, akin to engravings of the era, with detailed attention to the clothing and expressions of the figures, imbuing the piece with a narrative quality.
